['Open Grid Europe GmbH '].company_description: The Open Grid Europe GmbH is a long-distance gas transmission network operator. Open Grid Europe operates the largest natural gas pipeline network in Germany, spanning approximately 12,000 km. This includes its interests in pipelines such as MEGAL, TENP, NETRA, DEUDAN, and others. Open Grid is a part of the Trading Hub Europe market area. In the service sector, the company is engaged in engineering and operational planning, consulting, monitoring, and maintenance, primarily for gas transmission network operators but also for pipelines in the chemical industry, water supply, district heating, and more.

['Siltronic AG '].company_description: Siltronic AG is a manufacturer of wafers made of hyperpure silicon, the basis for modern micro- and nanotechnology. The Munich-based company is one of the world's leading manufacturers of wafers for the semiconductor industry.
